problem_agitate.label: Problem Agitate
problem_agitate.copy_instruction:
Make the audience fully realize the impact of their problem and the cost of doing nothing. Expand the consequences of the problem without exaggeration.
STRUCTURE — h1 states or intensifies the pain itself (NOT the solution or relief) — make the cost of inaction felt, urgent. h2 deepens the specific consequence — what keeps getting worse or what's being lost the longer this goes unaddressed. cta uses urgent, act-now language. Do not mention relief, results, or resolution anywhere except the CTA.
problem_agitate.visual_treatment: Depict the specific moment of frustration or difficulty from the persona's story — visible tension, unresolved struggle, before any relief. Facial expression and body language should show the weight of the problem, not calm or ease.

contrarian.label: Contrarian Truth
contrarian.copy_instruction:
Challenge a common belief and replace it with a different perspective. Formula: Everyone believes X. Actually, Y.
STRUCTURE — h1 must follow a myth-vs-truth contrast formula, e.g. 'Ramai sangka [common belief]... Sebenarnya [surprising truth]' — never a plain claim or benefit statement. h2 backs the surprising truth with one real product fact from BENEFITS/DESCRIPTION above. cta invites them to discover or experience the real approach, not a generic 'buy now'.
contrarian.visual_treatment: Frame the scene with an unexpected visual twist or contrast — something that visually interrupts the expected pattern for this persona's situation, prompting a second look.

social_proof.label: Social Proof
social_proof.copy_instruction:
Show that other people already trust or use the product. Use customer stories, long brand history, testimonials, repeat buyers.
STRUCTURE — h1 opens with a trust/social-validation signal (years trusted, widely used, real-customer phrasing) — NOT a product benefit or feature claim. h2 reinforces with one specific, concrete trust detail (a number, a heritage fact, a certification tied to trust — pull only from CERTIFICATIONS/DESCRIPTION above, never invent a statistic). cta uses join-the-community framing ('sertai jutaan yang...', 'seperti keluarga lain yang...').
social_proof.visual_treatment: Testimonial-style composition — the person could be mid-conversation or recommending to someone else, or the scene could include a review/rating visual element. Emphasize trust and shared experience over a solitary moment.

authority.label: Authority / Expertise
authority.copy_instruction:
Use credible facts instead of opinions. Use ingredients, certifications, experience, research, manufacturing quality.
STRUCTURE — h1 leads with a credible fact, certification, ingredient, or heritage claim — NO emotional hook, fact-first tone. h2 briefly explains the mechanism/evidence — why or how it works, pulled only from DESCRIPTION/CERTIFICATIONS above. cta is confident and credibility-based ('Formula terbukti', 'Dipercayai...') — not urgent or emotional.
authority.visual_treatment: Cleaner, more credential-forward framing — closer focus on product/ingredient detail, less busy lifestyle scene, a more clinical and confident composition.

curiosity.label: Curiosity
curiosity.copy_instruction:
Create an information gap that makes people want to know more. Ask questions or tease an unexpected fact without clickbait.
STRUCTURE — h1 poses a genuine question or teases an unexpected fact about the problem/product — it must NOT resolve the problem or reveal the solution yet. h2 deepens the intrigue with one more detail, still without fully answering it. cta uses discover/find-out framing ('Ketahui sebabnya', 'Terokai rahsianya') — not a hard sell.
curiosity.visual_treatment: Mysterious or intriguing framing — partial reveal, a tighter crop, product held with a questioning or curious expression. Leave something visually unresolved.

comparison.label: Comparison
comparison.copy_instruction:
Help people understand value by comparing two options. Compare old vs new, difficult vs easy, capsules vs jelly, before vs today.
STRUCTURE — h1 is a direct comparison statement naming both sides of the contrast in one line (old way vs new way / with vs without / difficult vs easy). h2 names the ONE specific point that makes the new/better side clearly superior, from BENEFITS above. cta uses switch/upgrade framing ('Beralih sekarang', 'Rasai bezanya').
comparison.visual_treatment: Split-screen or before/after style composition contrasting two states — old vs new, difficult vs easy — within the same frame.

transformation.label: Transformation
transformation.copy_instruction:
Sell the desired outcome rather than the product itself. Focus on life before and after solving the problem.
STRUCTURE — h1 frames the arc from struggle to relief in one line — name the DESTINATION (the outcome), not just the problem. h2 names the specific transformation/outcome achieved, concrete not vague. cta uses aspirational, start-the-journey framing ('Mulakan perubahan anda').
transformation.visual_treatment: Explicit before-to-after visual arc — show the persona's transition from struggle to relief within the composition, emphasizing the outcome/aspiration rather than the problem.
